projects.description:
About: Decode a VIN

Language / tech / stack: JavaScript, localStorage, UIkit, HTML, CSS

Production or Portfolio Item: Production

The logo, other images, and all other aesthetics were designed by me. Features a way to switch site into a dark mode which is persistent when returning to the site by using localStorage.
